# bugfree.ai

> AI-powered interview preparation platform for mastering system design, data science, and behavioral interviews with real-time feedback.

bugfree.ai provides 150+ practice problems with AI-powered feedback across system design, data science, and machine learning domains. The platform leverages advanced AI to help candidates prepare for technical interviews at top companies like Meta, Amazon, and other major tech firms.

## Key Topics

- System Design Interview
- Data Science Interview
- AI Feedback
- Interview Preparation
- Object-Oriented Design
- Machine Learning Design
- Statistics
- Hypothesis Testing
- Data Engineering
- Practice Problems
- Stochastic Process
- Probability
- SQL & Databases
- Apache Spark
- Meta & Amazon

## System Design Practice

- [System Design Interview Questions - 150+ Practice Problems with AI Feedback](https://bugfree.ai/practice/system-design): Practice 150+ system design questions with AI feedback on architecture, OOP, and ML systems.
- [2026 Must-have List for System Design Interview Questions](https://bugfree.ai/collection/system-design-top): Curated must-solve system design questions for 2026 interview preparation.
- [Design Facebook Job Board](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/design-facebook-job-board): System design: Facebook job board with product design and competitive analysis.

## Data Science & Statistics

- [Addressing Technical Debt Challenges](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/addressing-technical-debt-challenges): Data science interview practice: technical debt challenges with AI-powered feedback.
- [Choosing Right Statistical Measure](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/choosing-right-statistical-measure): Master statistical measures: mean vs median, confidence intervals, bootstrapping.
- [Assessing Monthly Variations Time Series](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/assessing-monthly-variations-time-series): Time-series analysis practice: seasonal decomposition and hypothesis testing.
- [Distinguishing Linear Regression T Test](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/distinguishing-linear-regression-t-test): Linear regression vs t-test: statistical analysis fundamentals for interviews.

## Probability & Stochastic Processes

- [Coin Toss Game Probability](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/coin-toss-game-probability): Gambler's Ruin probability problem using Markov chains and random walks.
- [Arranging Birthdays Circular Table](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/arranging-birthdays-circular-table): Practice circular permutations and probability with data science interview question.
- [Drawing Diverse Balls](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/drawing-diverse-balls): Pigeonhole principle and worst-case probability problem-solving practice.
- [Convergence Custom Die](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/convergence-custom-die): Stochastic process convergence problem with simulation approach.

## Data Engineering & Big Data

- [Comparing Dataframes Rdds](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/comparing-dataframes-rdds): Apache Spark: compare DataFrames vs RDDs with Catalyst optimizer insights.
- [Comparing Joins And Relationships](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/comparing-joins-and-relationships): SQL joins and database relationships practice for data engineering interviews.

## Product & Analytics Scenarios

- [Assessing Misinformation Facebook](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/assessing-misinformation-facebook): Data science interview: assess misinformation detection on Facebook platform.
- [Evaluating Ad Raters Part 2](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/evaluating-ad-raters-part-2): Bayes' theorem and conditional probability for ad rater evaluation.
- [Evaluating Discounted Email Campaigns](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/evaluating-discounted-email-campaigns): Email campaign analysis: revenue impact and discount strategy evaluation.

## Optional

- [Comparing Panel And Cross Sectional Data](https://bugfree.ai/data-question/comparing-panel-and-cross-sectional-data): Distinguish panel data from cross-sectional data in longitudinal analysis.
